anchor.create.description: Creates a named hyperlink destination at the text cursor or selection; the name defaults to the selected text.
anchor.create.when: Use when you need a target that hyperlinks or cross-references can jump to inside the document.

anchor.list.description: Lists all hyperlink destinations (anchors) defined in the document.
anchor.list.when: Use when you need existing anchor names before creating a hyperlink or cross-reference to one.

anchored.insert.description: Moves the given objects into the text at the cursor as anchored objects, inline, above the line or at a custom position.
anchored.insert.when: Use when an image or frame must travel with a specific spot in the text flow.

anchored.options.description: Changes how anchored objects sit in the text: inline, above line or custom position, with optional x and y offsets.
anchored.options.when: Use when an already anchored object needs repositioning relative to its text, not when anchoring it for the first time.

anchored.release.description: Releases anchored objects from the text so they become ordinary free-floating page objects again.
anchored.release.when: Use when an anchored object should stop following the text and stay fixed on the page.

book.add.description: Adds a document file at the given path to the open book.
book.add.when: Use when assembling chapters into a book so they share numbering and styles.

book.close.when: Use when you are finished working with the book and want to release it.

book.exportPdf.description: Exports every document in the book as one PDF at the given path, with an optional title.
book.exportPdf.when: Use when you need a single PDF of the whole book rather than one chapter.

book.list.description: Lists the documents in the open book with their order and page ranges.
book.list.when: Use when you need to see which chapters the book holds before changing it.

book.new.description: Creates a new empty book file at the given path.
book.new.when: Use when starting a multi-document publication that needs shared numbering and styles.

book.paginate.description: Updates page and section numbering across all documents in the book.
book.paginate.when: Use when chapters were added, removed or reordered and page numbers must run on correctly.

book.styleSource.description: Sets which book document, by index, is the style source for synchronizing.
book.styleSource.when: Use when choosing the master chapter whose styles and swatches the others should match.

book.syncStyles.description: Synchronizes styles and swatches across the book documents from the style source.
book.syncStyles.when: Use when chapters have drifted apart in styling and should all match the style source.

bookmark.add.description: Adds a PDF bookmark for a page, with optional name, level (1 or 2) and vertical position; the name defaults to the selected text.
bookmark.add.when: Use when exported PDFs need a navigable outline entry for a page or heading.

bookmark.delete.description: Deletes the PDF bookmark at the given index.
bookmark.delete.when: Use when a bookmark is obsolete and should not appear in the exported PDF.

bookmark.list.description: Lists all PDF bookmarks with their names, pages and levels.
bookmark.list.when: Use when you need to inspect bookmarks before adding or deleting one.

button.clear.description: Converts the selected buttons back into ordinary objects.
button.clear.when: Use when an object should stop acting as an interactive button.

button.list.description: Lists the interactive buttons in the document and their actions.
button.list.when: Use when you need to review button actions before editing them.

button.set.description: Turns selected objects into buttons with an action: go to a page, first, last, next or previous page, or open a URL.
button.set.when: Use when an object in an interactive PDF should navigate or open a link on click.

changes.accept.description: Accepts one tracked change in a story at the given position.
changes.accept.when: Use when approving a single tracked edit rather than all of them.

changes.acceptAll.description: Accepts every tracked change in the current story.
changes.acceptAll.when: Use when all tracked edits in a story are approved and should become final text.

changes.list.description: Lists tracked changes in the document with their story and position.
changes.list.when: Use when you need to find tracked edits before accepting or rejecting them.

changes.reject.description: Rejects one tracked change in a story at the given position, restoring the original text.
changes.reject.when: Use when undoing a single tracked edit rather than all of them.

changes.rejectAll.description: Rejects every tracked change in the current story, restoring the original text.
changes.rejectAll.when: Use when all tracked edits in a story should be discarded.

changes.track.description: Turns Track Changes on or off for the current story.
changes.track.when: Use when edits to text should be recorded for review instead of applied silently.

color.convert.description: Converts a color value to another model: CMYK, RGB, hex or gray, and returns the result.
color.convert.when: Use when you only need a converted color value, not a new swatch or a recolored object.

color.loadProfile.description: Loads an ICC color profile from the given file path for use in color settings.
color.loadProfile.when: Use when a custom RGB or CMYK profile must be available before choosing it in color settings.

color.settings.description: Sets the document color management: RGB and CMYK profiles, rendering intent and black point compensation.
color.settings.when: Use when changing how colors are interpreted and converted for output.

condition.apply.description: Applies a named condition to the selected text, or clears conditions when null is given.
condition.apply.when: Use when tagging text for a variant of the document, such as print only or web only.

condition.delete.description: Deletes a condition, optionally moving its tagged text to another condition.
condition.delete.when: Use when a condition is no longer needed and its text should be kept or reassigned.

condition.list.description: Lists the conditions defined in the document and their visibility.
condition.list.when: Use when you need to see existing conditions before applying or editing one.

condition.new.description: Creates a conditional text tag with a name, indicator color and visibility.
condition.new.when: Use when you need a new label for text variants in the document.

condition.options.description: Edits a condition: rename it, change its indicator color or show or hide its text.
condition.options.when: Use when toggling a variant's visibility or restyling an existing condition.

data.fields.description: Lists the field names of the loaded data merge source.
data.fields.when: Use when you need the exact field names before inserting placeholders.

data.insertField.description: Inserts a <<Field>> placeholder for the named data field at the text cursor.
data.insertField.when: Use when building a merge template that pulls values from the loaded data source.

data.load.description: Loads a data source for merging from text or a file path, as comma, tab or semicolon separated values.
data.load.when: Use when starting a data merge and the records are not yet loaded.

data.merge.description: Opens a new document with pages repeated per record, <<Field>> placeholders replaced and picture frames filled from paths.
data.merge.when: Use when producing the final merged output such as labels, cards or letters from the loaded data.

document.inspect.description: Returns an overview of the open document: pages, spreads, layers, stories and objects.
document.inspect.when: Use when you need to understand the current document structure before making changes.

document.preferences.description: Sets document units for horizontal and vertical measurements and the baseline grid start and increment.
document.preferences.when: Use when changing measurement units or the baseline grid used for text alignment.

edit.autocorrect.description: Turns autocorrect on or off, sets misspelling and correction pairs and capitalization behavior.
edit.autocorrect.when: Use when typing should automatically fix specific misspellings or capitalization.

edit.clear.description: Deletes the selected objects or text without copying them to the clipboard.
edit.clear.when: Use when removing content and the clipboard should stay untouched.

edit.clipboard.description: Returns what is currently on the application clipboard.
edit.clipboard.when: Use when you need to check the clipboard contents before pasting.

edit.copy.description: Copies the selected objects or text to the clipboard and returns the plain text for the system clipboard.
edit.copy.when: Use when duplicating content elsewhere via paste while leaving the original in place.

edit.cut.description: Removes the selected objects or text and places them on the clipboard.
edit.cut.when: Use when moving content to another place with paste.

edit.deselectAll.description: Clears the current selection of objects and text.
edit.deselectAll.when: Use when you need a clean state so the next command does not act on a previous selection.

edit.paste.description: Pastes the clipboard at the text cursor or onto the spread, optionally centered on a point.
edit.paste.when: Use when placing copied content; use paste in place to keep exact coordinates.

edit.pasteInPlace.description: Pastes copied objects onto the spread at exactly their original coordinates.
edit.pasteInPlace.when: Use when a copy must land at the same position, for example on another page.

edit.pasteInto.description: Puts the copied picture inside the selected frame, keeping where it sat on the page.
edit.pasteInto.when: Use when masking a copied picture or object with an existing frame.

edit.pasteWithoutFormatting.description: Pastes the clipboard text without its character and paragraph formatting.
edit.pasteWithoutFormatting.when: Use when pasted text should take on the destination styling instead of the source look.

edit.redo.when: Use when you undid something by mistake and want it back.

edit.selectAll.description: Selects all objects on the spread, or all text in the current story.
edit.selectAll.when: Use when a command should act on everything rather than a chosen set of ids.

edit.selectContainer.description: Selects the frame that contains the current content selection.
edit.selectContainer.when: Use when you have selected a picture inside a frame and now need the frame itself.

edit.selectContent.description: Selects the content (such as the picture) inside the selected frame.
edit.selectContent.when: Use when you need to move or scale the picture inside its frame.

edit.selectNext.description: Selects the next object in stacking order, or the previous one with previous set.
edit.selectNext.when: Use when stepping through overlapping objects one at a time.

edit.stepAndRepeat.description: Duplicates the selection repeatedly with a count and x/y offset, or into a grid of rows and columns.
edit.stepAndRepeat.when: Use when you need many evenly spaced copies, such as a grid of cards or tickets.

edit.undo.description: Undoes the last action in the document.
edit.undo.when: Use when the previous change was wrong and should be reverted.

endnote.frame.description: Creates or sets the frame on a page where document endnotes are collected, with an optional title.
endnote.frame.when: Use when endnotes need a home on a specific page, for example at the end of a chapter.

endnote.insert.description: Inserts a superscript endnote reference at the cursor and stores the note text, numbered in page order.
endnote.insert.when: Use when adding a note that should be gathered at the end instead of at the page bottom.

endnote.list.description: Lists all endnotes with their ids, numbers and text.
endnote.list.when: Use when you need endnote ids before editing one.

endnote.set.description: Replaces the text of an existing endnote by id.
endnote.set.when: Use when correcting the wording of an endnote that already exists.

file.close.when: Use when finished with the document; unsaved changes are not recoverable by Undo.

file.exportEpub.description: Exports the document as a reflowable EPUB with optional title, author, language, cover and output path.
file.exportEpub.when: Use when the ebook text should reflow to the reader's screen size.

file.exportFixedEpub.description: Exports the document as a fixed-layout EPUB that keeps page design, with optional title, author, language and path.
file.exportFixedEpub.when: Use when the ebook must keep the exact page layout, such as picture books or magazines.

file.exportHtml.description: Exports the document as HTML with optional title, language and output path.
file.exportHtml.when: Use when you need a web page version of the content.

file.exportIdml.description: Exports the document as an InDesign Markup (IDML) file, optionally embedding images.
file.exportIdml.when: Use when exchanging the layout with InDesign or other tools that read IDML.

file.exportPdf.description: Exports the document as a PDF with page range, bleed, printer marks, PDF standard, tagging and spreads options.
file.exportPdf.when: Use when you need a PDF for print or screen; use export separations for per-ink plates.

file.exportSeparations.description: Exports one plate per ink as PDF or PNG files, with page range, bleed, chosen inks and printer marks.
file.exportSeparations.when: Use when checking or delivering separate color plates rather than a composite PDF.

file.exportSvg.description: Exports one page as an SVG vector file at the given path.
file.exportSvg.when: Use when a single page or design should become a scalable vector graphic.

file.exportText.description: Exports the current story as a plain text, RTF or tagged text file.
file.exportText.when: Use when the copy needs to leave the layout as a text file.

file.exportXml.description: Exports the tagged document structure and content as an XML file.
file.exportXml.when: Use when delivering structured content for databases or publishing pipelines.

file.importXml.description: Imports XML content given as text into the document structure.
file.importXml.when: Use when filling tagged frames with data from an XML source.

file.interactiveInfo.description: Returns the interactive PDF contents for chosen pages: links, buttons, forms, media and transitions.
file.interactiveInfo.when: Use when verifying what interactive features an exported PDF will carry.

file.new.description: Creates a new document with size or preset, page count, facing pages, margins, columns, gutter, bleed and intent.
file.new.when: Use when starting a fresh layout from scratch.

file.open.description: Opens a document from a file path.
file.open.when: Use when the document file is on disk; use openBytes when you have the file data instead.

file.openBytes.description: Opens a document from base64 file data with a given name.
file.openBytes.when: Use when the document arrives as bytes rather than as a path on disk.

file.openIdml.description: Opens an IDML file supplied as base64 data with a name.
file.openIdml.when: Use when importing an InDesign Markup file that is not on disk.

file.package.description: Collects the document, fonts, links and optional IDML, PDF and instructions into a folder for handoff.
file.package.when: Use when sending the job to a printer or colleague with everything it needs.

file.place.description: Places an image or text file into a frame or the page, from a path or from base64 data.
file.place.when: Use when bringing external pictures or text into the layout.

file.print.description: Sends the document to a printer with copies, pages, bleed, separations, inks and printer marks.
file.print.when: Use when you need physical output; use PDF export for a file.

file.printBooklet.description: Prints or outputs booklet imposition such as 2-up saddle stitch or perfect bound, with spacing and creep.
file.printBooklet.when: Use when pages must be imposed in printer spreads for folding into a booklet.

file.printers.description: Lists the printers available for printing.
file.printers.when: Use when you need a printer name before printing.

file.recovery.list.description: Lists recoverable unsaved documents in the given recovery folder.
file.recovery.list.when: Use when checking whether lost work can be restored.

file.recovery.open.description: Opens unsaved documents recovered from the given recovery folder.
file.recovery.open.when: Use when restoring work after a crash or accidental close.

file.recovery.save.description: Writes recovery data for the open document to the given folder.
file.recovery.save.when: Use when creating a safety copy so work can be restored later.

file.save.description: Saves the document to its current file, overwriting the previous version.
file.save.when: Use when keeping changes in the existing file; use Save As for a new name.

file.saveAs.description: Saves the document under a new path.
file.saveAs.when: Use when you want a separate copy or a new file name.

find.change.description: Replaces all matches of text or a GREP pattern, with case, whole word, scope, format and locked or hidden options.
find.change.when: Use when you want to bulk replace text or formatting across the document.

find.changeObjects.description: Finds objects by fill, stroke, weight, opacity or style and changes their fill, stroke, weight, opacity or object style.
find.changeObjects.when: Use when restyling many objects that share an appearance.

find.find.description: Finds the first match of text or a GREP pattern in the document, story or selection.
find.find.when: Use when locating text before editing it; use change all to replace.

find.next.description: Repeats the last search and moves to the next match.
find.next.when: Use when stepping through matches after a find.

find.objects.description: Finds objects by opacity, fill, stroke, weight, layer, object style or kind, optionally selecting them.
find.objects.when: Use when you need ids of objects matching an appearance, rather than text matches.

font.list.description: Lists the fonts used in the document and whether each is available.
font.list.when: Use when checking for missing fonts or planning a font replacement.

font.replace.description: Replaces one font family and optional style with another throughout the document.
font.replace.when: Use when swapping a missing or unwanted font everywhere at once.

footnote.insert.description: Inserts a footnote at the cursor with optional text and style.
footnote.insert.when: Use when a note belongs at the bottom of the same column or page.

footnote.list.description: Lists footnotes in a story with their positions and text.
footnote.list.when: Use when you need footnote positions before editing one.

footnote.set.description: Replaces the text of a footnote at a position in a story.
footnote.set.when: Use when correcting an existing footnote.

form.clear.description: Converts selected form fields back into ordinary objects.
form.clear.when: Use when an object should stop being an interactive form field.

form.list.description: Lists the PDF form fields in the document.
form.list.when: Use when reviewing form fields before editing them.

form.set.description: Makes selected objects PDF form fields with kind, name, value, options, multiline, required and font size.
form.set.when: Use when building fillable PDF forms with text boxes, checkboxes or lists.

frame.create.description: Creates a rectangle, ellipse or polygon frame from a rectangle, as a text, graphic or unassigned frame, with optional text.
frame.create.when: Use when adding a new text or picture box; use line.create for a line.

frame.thread.description: Links one text frame to another so text flows from the first into the second.
frame.thread.when: Use when text should continue across columns or pages through connected frames.

frame.unthread.description: Breaks the text thread after the given frame so text no longer flows onward.
frame.unthread.when: Use when frames should stop sharing one story.

guide.add.description: Adds a horizontal or vertical ruler guide at a position on a spread, optionally across the spread.
guide.add.when: Use when you need a single manual alignment line; use create guides for a grid.

guide.delete.description: Deletes one ruler guide by index, or all guides on a spread.
guide.delete.when: Use when clearing guides that are no longer needed.

guide.list.description: Lists the ruler guides on a spread.
guide.list.when: Use when you need guide indexes before editing or deleting one.

guide.set.description: Edits a ruler guide's position, color or locked state.
guide.set.when: Use when moving or locking an existing guide.

hyperlink.create.description: Links selected text or an object to a web address, email, page or named anchor; exports carry it.
hyperlink.create.when: Use when text or an object should be clickable in PDF or EPUB.

hyperlink.delete.description: Deletes the hyperlink with the given id.
hyperlink.delete.when: Use when a link should be removed but the text kept.

hyperlink.edit.description: Changes an existing hyperlink's name or destination: URL, email, page or anchor.
hyperlink.edit.when: Use when retargeting a link that already exists.

hyperlink.goToSource.description: Moves the selection to the source text or object of a hyperlink.
hyperlink.goToSource.when: Use when you need to find where a link sits in the layout.

hyperlink.list.description: Lists all hyperlinks with their ids, names and destinations.
hyperlink.list.when: Use when you need link ids before editing or deleting one.

hyphenation.addException.description: Adds a word with tildes marking allowed hyphenation points, such as ex~am~ple.
hyphenation.addException.when: Use when a word hyphenates badly and you want to control where it may break.

hyphenation.list.description: Lists the hyphenation exceptions in the document.
hyphenation.list.when: Use when reviewing custom hyphenation rules.

hyphenation.removeException.description: Removes a word from the hyphenation exceptions.
hyphenation.removeException.when: Use when a custom hyphenation rule is no longer wanted.

index.addReference.description: Adds an index page reference for a topic at the cursor, with optional subtopic or see reference.
index.addReference.when: Use when marking text so it appears in the generated index.

index.generate.description: Builds the index from page references into a frame, with optional title and section headings.
index.generate.when: Use when the index entries are marked and you need the index laid out.

index.list.description: Lists the index topics and their page references.
index.list.when: Use when reviewing index entries before generating the index.

ink.allToProcess.description: Converts all spot inks to process (CMYK) colors, or turns that off.
ink.allToProcess.when: Use when output should use only the four process inks.

ink.list.description: Lists the inks used in the document, process and spot.
ink.list.when: Use when you need ink names before changing them or exporting separations.

ink.options.description: Sets a spot ink to convert to process or alias to another spot ink, as in the Ink Manager.
ink.options.when: Use when merging spot inks or reducing the number of plates.

ink.plates.description: Lists the separation plates the document would output.
ink.plates.when: Use when checking which plates will print before output.

layer.activate.description: Makes a layer the active layer so new objects go onto it.
layer.activate.when: Use when new content should be created on a particular layer.

layer.delete.description: Deletes a layer and the objects on it.
layer.delete.when: Use when a layer and its content are no longer wanted.

layer.deleteUnused.description: Deletes all layers that contain no objects.
layer.deleteUnused.when: Use when cleaning up empty layers.

layer.merge.description: Merges several layers into one target layer.
layer.merge.when: Use when simplifying layers while keeping all their objects.

layer.move.description: Moves a layer to a new position in the layer stack.
layer.move.when: Use when changing which layer sits above another.

layer.new.description: Creates a new layer with an optional name and color.
layer.new.when: Use when you need a separate layer for new content.

layer.others.description: Shows, hides, locks or unlocks a layer by id.
layer.others.when: Use when toggling visibility or locking of a layer without changing other options.

layer.selectItems.description: Selects all objects on a layer.
layer.selectItems.when: Use when an action should apply to everything on one layer.

layer.set.description: Edits a layer's name, color, visible, locked and printable options.
layer.set.when: Use when renaming a layer or changing whether it prints.

layout.createAlternate.description: Creates an alternate layout with a new page size, using a liquid rule such as scale, recenter or guide.
layout.createAlternate.when: Use when adapting the design to another format, such as portrait to landscape.

layout.createGuides.description: Creates a grid of row and column guides with gutters, fitted to margins or page.
layout.createGuides.when: Use when you need a column and row grid; use guide.add for a single guide.

layout.detachAll.description: Detaches all objects on a page from their parent page, making them independent.
layout.detachAll.when: Use when parent items on a page should become editable page objects permanently.

layout.documentSetup.description: Changes document size, page count, start page, facing pages, intent, bleed and slug, optionally adjusting the layout.
layout.documentSetup.when: Use when changing the overall document properties after creation.

layout.marginsAndColumns.description: Sets margins, columns and gutter for chosen pages, optionally adjusting the layout.
layout.marginsAndColumns.when: Use when changing the text area grid of pages.

layout.overrideParentItems.description: Overrides all parent page items on a page so they can be edited locally.
layout.overrideParentItems.when: Use when you need to edit items that come from the parent page on one page.

layout.pageSize.description: Sets the width and height of specific pages.
layout.pageSize.when: Use when only some pages need a different size than the rest.

layout.pages.applyParent.description: Applies a parent page, or none, to the chosen pages.
layout.pages.applyParent.when: Use when pages should adopt a different parent layout.

layout.pages.delete.description: Deletes the chosen pages and their content.
layout.pages.delete.when: Use when removing pages from the document.

layout.pages.duplicateSpread.description: Duplicates a spread with all its contents.
layout.pages.duplicateSpread.when: Use when you want a copy of a finished spread to adapt.

layout.pages.insert.description: Inserts a number of new pages after a page, with an optional parent.
layout.pages.insert.when: Use when the document needs more pages.

layout.pages.move.description: Moves a page to a new position in the document.

layout.pages.toSpread.description: Adds a page to a spread, or joins pages into one spread.
layout.pages.toSpread.when: Use when building gatefolds or multi-page spreads.

layout.parents.edit.description: Turns parent page editing on or off.
layout.parents.edit.when: Use when you are about to edit parent pages instead of document pages.

layout.parents.new.description: Creates a new parent page with prefix, name and an optional parent it is based on.
layout.parents.new.when: Use when you need a new reusable page template.

layout.parents.options.description: Changes a parent page's prefix, name or the parent it is based on.
layout.parents.options.when: Use when renaming or rebasing an existing parent.

layout.removeOverrides.description: Removes all local overrides on a page so it matches its parent again.
layout.removeOverrides.when: Use when a page should return to the parent design.

layout.rotateSpreadView.description: Rotates the on-screen view of a spread by 90, 180 or 270 degrees without changing the content.
layout.rotateSpreadView.when: Use when you need to view or work on a spread sideways.

layout.section.description: Sets or removes a section start on a page, with start number, numbering style, prefix and section marker.
layout.section.when: Use when page numbering should restart or change style, such as roman front matter.

layout.spreadShuffle.description: Allows or prevents a spread from shuffling when pages are added or removed.
layout.spreadShuffle.when: Use when a spread must stay together as pages around it change.

line.create.description: Draws a straight line between two points with optional stroke weight.
line.create.when: Use when you need a simple line, rule or divider.

links.embed.description: Embeds a linked file into the document.
links.embed.when: Use when the document should be self-contained and not depend on the external file.

links.goTo.description: Selects and shows the object that uses the given linked file.
links.goTo.when: Use when locating where a linked asset sits in the layout.

links.list.description: Lists linked files with their status: ok, modified or missing.
links.list.when: Use when checking for missing or outdated links.

links.relink.description: Points a link to a different file path.
links.relink.when: Use when a linked file moved or has a replacement.

links.update.description: Updates a modified link, or all modified links, from the file on disk.
links.update.when: Use when linked pictures changed outside the document.

liquid.object.description: Sets liquid layout pins and resize behavior for objects: pin top, bottom, left, right, resize width and height.
liquid.object.when: Use when objects need individual rules for how they react to page resizing.

liquid.pageRule.description: Sets the liquid layout rule for pages: off, scale, recenter, guide-based or object-based.
liquid.pageRule.when: Use when choosing how a page's content adapts to size changes.

liquid.pageSize.description: Resizes pages and moves and resizes objects by each page's liquid rule, or a given rule.
liquid.pageSize.when: Use when changing page size and the content should adapt automatically.

list.define.description: Defines a numbered or bulleted list with options to span stories and continue from the previous list.
list.define.when: Use when numbering should run across multiple text frames or stories.

list.delete.description: Deletes a defined list by name.
list.delete.when: Use when a list definition is no longer needed.

list.list.when: Use when you need list names before applying or deleting one.

media.get.description: Returns details of a placed media object such as audio or video by id.
media.get.when: Use when inspecting a movie or sound before changing its options.

media.options.description: Sets media playback options: play on page load, loop and show controls.
media.options.when: Use when audio or video in an interactive document needs playback settings.

note.convertToText.description: Converts a note into regular text in the story.
note.convertToText.when: Use when a reviewer's note should become part of the actual copy.

note.delete.description: Deletes a note from a story.
note.delete.when: Use when a review note is resolved.

note.edit.description: Changes the text of an existing note.
note.edit.when: Use when updating a note rather than adding a new one.

note.list.description: Lists the notes in the document with their ids and text.
note.list.when: Use when reviewing comments left in the stories.

note.new.description: Adds a note at the text cursor with text and optional author.
note.new.when: Use when leaving a review comment inside the text.

object.align.description: Aligns objects to an edge or center: left, hcenter, right, top, vcenter or bottom, relative to selection, key object, margins, page or spread.
object.align.when: Use when lining up objects; use distribute to space them evenly.

object.altText.description: Sets alternative text for objects from custom text or from a name, label or file name.
object.altText.when: Use when making exported PDFs or EPUBs accessible with image descriptions.

object.arrange.description: Changes stacking order: bring to front, forward, backward or send to back.
object.arrange.when: Use when an object must sit above or below others.

object.attributes.description: Sets non-printing and overprint fill or stroke attributes of objects.
object.attributes.when: Use when an object should be excluded from output or overprint.

object.basicFeather.description: Applies a soft feathered edge with width, choke and corner type.
object.basicFeather.when: Use when softening the edges of an object evenly all around.

object.caption.description: Generates a static caption from alt text, name, label, file name or custom text, placed beside the object.
object.caption.when: Use when a caption should be fixed text rather than update with metadata.

object.clipToFrame.description: Turns the clipping path into the graphic frame's shape and drops the clip.
object.clipToFrame.when: Use when a clipped picture should become a plain frame in that shape.

object.clippingInfo.description: Reports the picture's clipping path settings, Photoshop path names, PSD alpha channels and transparency.
object.clippingInfo.when: Use when checking what clipping options a placed picture offers.

object.clippingPath.description: Clips a placed picture to a path found by edge detection, alpha channel or Photoshop path, with threshold, tolerance and inset.
object.clippingPath.when: Use when cutting a picture out of its background.

object.color.description: Applies a hex color to the fill or stroke of objects.
object.color.when: Use when you have a one-off hex color; use fill or stroke with a swatch to keep colors in the palette.

object.convertShape.description: Converts objects to another shape such as rectangle, rounded rectangle, ellipse, triangle, polygon or line.
object.convertShape.when: Use when changing a frame or shape type while keeping its position.

object.cornerOptions.description: Applies corner effects such as rounded, inverse rounded, inset, bevel or fancy with a size in points.
object.cornerOptions.when: Use when frames need decorative or rounded corners as a live option.

object.directionalFeather.description: Applies feathering from chosen sides (top, bottom, left, right) with choke and angle.
object.directionalFeather.when: Use when fading an object's edge only on certain sides.

object.distribute.description: Spaces objects evenly along an axis by centers or by equal gaps.
object.distribute.when: Use when objects need equal spacing; use align to line them up.

object.dropShadow.description: Applies a drop shadow with blend mode, opacity, distance, angle, size, spread and color.
object.dropShadow.when: Use when an object needs a shadow behind it.

object.duplicate.description: Duplicates objects, optionally offset by dx and dy.
object.duplicate.when: Use when you need one copy; use step and repeat for many.

object.fill.description: Fills objects with a named swatch at an optional tint.
object.fill.when: Use when coloring objects from the swatch palette.

object.fit.description: Fits content to a frame or a frame to its content: fill, fit proportionally, fit content to frame, center or fit frame to content.
object.fit.when: Use when a picture and its frame do not match in size.

object.fittingOptions.description: Sets frame fitting options: autofit, fitting mode and content alignment.
object.fittingOptions.when: Use when a frame should always fit its content a certain way when content changes.

object.gradient.description: Applies a linear or radial gradient with angle and color stops to objects.
object.gradient.when: Use when you need a custom gradient on an object rather than a saved gradient swatch.

object.gradientFeather.description: Applies a gradual fade (linear or radial) with angle and opacity stops.
object.gradientFeather.when: Use when an object should fade out smoothly in one direction.

object.group.description: Groups the selected objects so they move and transform together.
object.group.when: Use when several objects should be handled as one.

object.innerGlow.description: Applies a glow inside the object edges with blend mode, opacity, size, choke and color.
object.innerGlow.when: Use when highlighting an object's inner edge.

object.innerShadow.description: Applies a shadow inside the object with distance, angle, size, choke, blend mode and color.
object.innerShadow.when: Use when an object should look recessed.

object.label.description: Sets a script label on objects for identification.
object.label.when: Use when tagging objects so they can be found or referenced later.

object.layerOptions.description: Lists and toggles the layers of a placed PDF or PSD for this placement.
object.layerOptions.when: Use when showing or hiding layers inside a placed Photoshop or PDF file.

object.liveCaption.description: Generates a caption linked to image metadata (name, path, title, description, creator, dimensions or ppi) beside the object.
object.liveCaption.when: Use when the caption should update automatically from the picture's metadata.

object.opacity.description: Sets object opacity (0 to 1) and blend mode.
object.opacity.when: Use when making an object see-through or blending it with what is below.

object.outerGlow.description: Applies a glow outside the object with blend mode, opacity, size, spread, technique and color.
object.outerGlow.when: Use when an object needs a soft halo around it.

object.pathfinder.description: Combines closed shapes with add, subtract, intersect, exclude overlap, minus back, divide, trim, merge, crop or outline.
object.pathfinder.when: Use when building new shapes from overlapping ones.

object.primaryTextFrame.description: Marks the selected text frame as the primary text frame of its page.
object.primaryTextFrame.when: Use when autoflow should fill this frame first on new pages.

object.qrCode.description: Generates a QR code from text into a frame, with color swatch and quiet zone.
object.qrCode.when: Use when a scannable code is needed in the layout.

object.rename.when: Use when giving an object a recognizable name.

object.setFlags.when: Use when objects should be out of the way or protected from edits.

object.setLayer.description: Moves objects to a given layer.
object.setLayer.when: Use when objects belong on a different layer.

object.stroke.description: Sets stroke swatch, tint, weight, type, cap, join and alignment of objects, and how a gradient swatch runs on the stroke (gradientMode within, along or across).
object.stroke.when: Use when outlining objects or editing their border style, or when a gradient should follow a line's length or run across its width.

object.textFrameOptions.description: Sets text frame options: columns, gutter, inset, vertical justification, autosize, balanced columns, footnotes spanning all columns and text orientation.
object.textFrameOptions.when: Use when changing how text sits inside a frame, not the text itself.

object.textWrap.description: Sets text wrap around an object: none, bounding box, contour, jump object or jump to next column, with offset.
object.textWrap.when: Use when text should flow around a picture or shape.

object.ungroup.description: Ungroups the selected groups back into separate objects.
object.ungroup.when: Use when objects in a group need to be edited independently.

object.wrapContour.description: Sets the contour that a contour text wrap follows around a picture and turns the wrap to contour.
object.wrapContour.when: Use when text must hug the shape of a cut-out picture.

page.transition.description: Sets a page transition type and duration for a spread or all spreads.
page.transition.when: Use when adding an animation between pages in an interactive document.

page.transitions.description: Lists the page transitions set in the document.

path.average.description: Moves anchors to their average position: horizontal lines up on one y, vertical on one x, both stacks them.
path.average.when: Use when aligning anchor points on a path to a line or a point.

path.close.description: Closes open paths by connecting the last point to the first.
path.close.when: Use when an open path should become a closed shape.

path.compound.description: Combines paths into one compound path, with holes where they overlap.
path.compound.when: Use when you need cut-out shapes such as a donut.

path.expandCorners.description: Turns live corners and corner options into ordinary path geometry.
path.expandCorners.when: Use when rounded corners must become editable points.

path.join.description: Joins two open paths into one at their end points.
path.join.when: Use when connecting two open path segments.

path.offset.description: Makes a new path a set distance outside (or inside when negative) each shape, with miter, round or bevel joins.
path.offset.when: Use when you need a parallel outline such as an inset or outset border.

path.open.description: Opens closed paths by removing the closing segment.
path.open.when: Use when a closed shape should become an open line.

path.outlineStroke.description: Turns an object's stroke into a filled shape in the stroke color; caps, joins and dashes are kept.
path.outlineStroke.when: Use when a stroke must be edited or combined as a shape.

path.release.description: Releases a compound path into separate paths.
path.release.when: Use when a compound path should be split apart.

path.reverse.when: Use when arrowheads or text on a path must run the opposite way.

path.roundCorners.description: Rounds corners at anchors with a radius and kind: round, inverted round, chamfer or inset; stays live.
path.roundCorners.when: Use when you need rounded corners on selected anchors of a path.

path.simplify.description: Reduces the anchor points of paths while keeping their shape within a tolerance.
path.simplify.when: Use when a path has too many points.

path.smooth.description: Turns anchors into smooth points with handles along the path.
path.smooth.when: Use when jagged corners should become flowing curves.

place.load.description: Loads files into the place cursor to place one after another.
place.load.when: Use when placing several pictures or texts by clicking each in turn.

preflight.run.description: Checks the document for output problems such as missing fonts, links and overset text.
preflight.run.when: Use when verifying the document is ready before export or package.

script.run.description: Runs a list of commands in order, each with its command id and params, as one batch.
script.run.when: Use when several commands should execute together as a sequence.

selection.set.description: Selects the given object ids, optionally adding to the current selection.
selection.set.when: Use when later commands should act on specific objects.

selection.toggle.description: Toggles one object in or out of the selection.
selection.toggle.when: Use when adjusting a selection by one object.

snippet.export.description: Exports the selected objects as a snippet (base64) that can be placed later.
snippet.export.when: Use when you want to reuse selected objects in another document.

snippet.place.description: Places a snippet from base64 data onto a spread at an optional position.
snippet.place.when: Use when inserting objects previously exported as a snippet.

spelling.addWord.description: Adds a word to the user dictionary.
spelling.addWord.when: Use when a correctly spelled word keeps getting flagged.

spelling.change.description: Replaces a misspelled range of a story with corrected text, by byte offsets.
spelling.change.when: Use when applying a spelling correction found by the check.

spelling.check.description: Checks spelling in the document and returns the misspelled words.

spelling.setWords.description: Replaces the user dictionary with the given list of words.
spelling.setWords.when: Use when setting the whole dictionary in one step.

spelling.words.description: Lists the words in the user dictionary.
spelling.words.when: Use when reviewing the custom dictionary.

states.create.description: Creates a multi-state object from the selected objects.
states.create.when: Use when objects should switch between alternate versions in an interactive document.

states.list.description: Lists the states of a multi-state object.
states.list.when: Use when checking which states exist.

states.release.description: Releases a multi-state object into separate objects.
states.release.when: Use when states should become ordinary objects again.

states.rename.description: Renames a state of a multi-state object.
states.rename.when: Use when giving a state a clearer name.

states.show.description: Shows the chosen state of a multi-state object.
states.show.when: Use when switching which state is visible.

story.get.description: Returns the text and structure of a story or the story in a frame.
story.get.when: Use when you need to read the copy of a text frame.

story.paras.description: Lists the paragraphs of a story with their offsets and styles.
story.paras.when: Use when you need paragraph positions or styles before editing.

story.replaceRange.description: Replaces a range of a story, given by byte offsets, with new text.
story.replaceRange.when: Use when editing part of a story without touching the cursor.

story.setText.description: Replaces the whole text of a story or frame.
story.setText.when: Use when rewriting a frame's entire copy.

style.cell.apply.description: Applies a cell style to the selected table cells.
style.cell.apply.when: Use when cells should take a saved cell format.

style.cell.create.description: Creates a cell style from a name and attributes or from the selected cell.
style.cell.create.when: Use when saving a cell format for reuse.

style.cell.edit.description: Edits a cell style: fill, tint, vertical justification, insets, strokes, paragraph style, rotation, slanted text, diagonals, column width and minimum or exact row height.
style.cell.edit.when: Use when changing an existing cell style's formatting.

style.character.apply.description: Applies a character style to the selected text.
style.character.apply.when: Use when a run of text should take a saved character format.

style.character.create.description: Creates a character style with a name, attributes, base style or from the selection.
style.character.create.when: Use when saving character formatting for reuse.

style.character.delete.description: Deletes a character style, optionally replacing its uses with another style.
style.character.delete.when: Use when a character style is obsolete.

style.character.edit.description: Edits a character style: rename, base style and character attributes.
style.character.edit.when: Use when changing an existing character style.

style.get.description: Returns the definition of one style by kind and name.
style.get.when: Use when you need a style's attributes before editing it.

style.group.description: Puts styles of a kind into a named style group.
style.group.when: Use when organizing styles into folders.

style.list.description: Lists all styles of every kind in the document.
style.list.when: Use when you need style names before applying or editing.

style.load.description: Loads styles, and optionally swatches, from another file by path or base64, choosing kinds and overwrite.
style.load.when: Use when importing styles from another document.

style.object.apply.description: Applies an object style to objects.
style.object.apply.when: Use when objects should take a saved object format.

style.object.create.description: Creates an object style from a name and attributes or from the selected object.
style.object.create.when: Use when saving object formatting for reuse.

style.object.delete.description: Deletes an object style, optionally replacing its uses with another style.
style.object.delete.when: Use when an object style is obsolete.

style.object.edit.description: Edits an object style: rename and attributes.
style.object.edit.when: Use when changing an existing object style.

style.paragraph.apply.description: Applies a paragraph style to the selected paragraphs, optionally clearing overrides.
style.paragraph.apply.when: Use when paragraphs should take a saved paragraph format.

style.paragraph.create.description: Creates a paragraph style from a name and paragraph and character attributes, a base style, next style or the selection.
style.paragraph.create.when: Use when saving paragraph formatting for reuse.

style.paragraph.delete.description: Deletes a paragraph style, optionally replacing its uses with another style.
style.paragraph.delete.when: Use when a paragraph style is obsolete.

style.paragraph.edit.description: Edits a paragraph style: rename, base style, next style, paragraph and character attributes.
style.paragraph.edit.when: Use when changing an existing paragraph style.

style.table.apply.description: Applies a table style to the selected table.
style.table.apply.when: Use when a table should take a saved table format.

style.table.create.description: Creates a table style with border, alternating fills and strokes and cell styles for header, footer, columns and body.
style.table.create.when: Use when saving table formatting for reuse.

style.table.edit.description: Edits a table style: border, alternating row and column fills and strokes, and cell styles per region.
style.table.edit.when: Use when changing an existing table style.

swatch.create.description: Creates a color swatch from a name and a hex, CMYK percent value, optionally as a spot color.
swatch.create.when: Use when adding a color to the palette.

swatch.createGradient.description: Creates a gradient swatch, linear or radial, with color stops.
swatch.createGradient.when: Use when a gradient should be reusable from the palette.

swatch.createTint.description: Creates a tint swatch of a base swatch at a percent.
swatch.createTint.when: Use when you need a lighter version of an existing swatch.

swatch.delete.description: Deletes a swatch, optionally replacing its uses with another swatch.
swatch.delete.when: Use when a swatch is no longer needed.

swatch.edit.description: Edits a swatch: color value, spot flag or name.
swatch.edit.when: Use when changing a swatch that objects already use.

swatch.group.description: Puts swatches into a named color group.

swatch.list.description: Lists the swatches in the document.
swatch.list.when: Use when you need swatch names before using them.

swatch.mixedInk.description: Creates a mixed ink swatch from process and spot ink components with tint percentages.
swatch.mixedInk.when: Use when combining a spot ink with process inks in one swatch.

swatch.mixedInkGroup.description: Creates a group of mixed ink swatches stepping through ink tints by initial, repeat and increment.
swatch.mixedInkGroup.when: Use when you need a series of mixed inks in steps.

swatch.save.description: Saves the document swatches to a swatch file.
swatch.save.when: Use when exporting the palette for reuse in other documents.

table.cellStrokes.description: Sets strokes on chosen sides of the selected cells: weight, color, tint and type.

table.convertCell.description: Converts the selected cell to a graphic or text cell.
table.convertCell.when: Use when a cell should hold a picture or go back to text.

table.deleteColumn.description: Deletes the column of the selected cells.
table.deleteColumn.when: Use when removing a column from a table.

table.deleteRow.description: Deletes the row of the selected cells.
table.deleteRow.when: Use when removing a row from a table.

table.distributeColumns.description: Makes the selected columns the same width.
table.distributeColumns.when: Use when columns should be equal.

table.fromText.description: Converts selected text to a table splitting on tab, comma or semicolon, with header rows.
table.fromText.when: Use when text data should become a table.

table.get.description: Returns the selected table's structure and contents.
table.get.when: Use when inspecting a table before editing it.

table.insert.description: Inserts a table with rows, columns, header and footer rows and an optional style.
table.insert.when: Use when creating a table from scratch.

table.insertColumnLeft.description: Inserts columns to the left of the selected cell.
table.insertColumnLeft.when: Use when adding columns before the current one.

table.insertColumnRight.description: Inserts columns to the right of the selected cell.
table.insertColumnRight.when: Use when adding columns after the current one.

table.insertRowAbove.description: Inserts rows above the selected cell.
table.insertRowAbove.when: Use when adding rows before the current one.

table.insertRowBelow.description: Inserts rows below the selected cell.
table.insertRowBelow.when: Use when adding rows after the current one.

table.merge.description: Merges the selected cells into one.
table.merge.when: Use when a cell must span rows or columns.

table.options.description: Sets table options: header and footer rows, border, alternating fills and strokes, region cell styles, rounded corners (cornerRadius), rows that split across frames (splitRows), a continued label in later frames (continued), and alt text and a summary for accessible exports.
table.options.when: Use when overriding a table's overall look instead of a table style.

table.placeInCell.description: Places an image from a path into the selected cell, with fitting and alt text.
table.placeInCell.when: Use when a cell should show a picture.

table.select.description: Selects table cells by row and column, optionally a range; add keeps earlier ranges so non-adjacent rows, columns or cells are selected together, and rows picks whole rows by number.
table.select.when: Use when later table commands should act on specific cells, including scattered rows such as every other total row.

table.setCell.description: Sets cell options: vertical justification, insets, fill, tint, rotation, slanted header text, diagonals and paragraph style.
table.setCell.when: Use when formatting the content area of cells.

table.setColumnWidth.description: Sets the width of the selected columns.
table.setColumnWidth.when: Use when a column needs a specific width.

table.setRowHeight.description: Sets the height of the selected rows, at least or exactly.
table.setRowHeight.when: Use when a row needs a specific height.

table.sortRows.description: Sorts table rows by a column, ascending or descending.
table.sortRows.when: Use when table data should be ordered.

table.splitCell.description: Splits the selected cell horizontally or vertically.
table.splitCell.when: Use when a cell should become several.

table.toText.description: Converts a table to text separated by tabs, commas or semicolons.
table.toText.when: Use when table content should go back to plain text.

table.unmerge.when: Use when a merged cell should return to separate cells.

text.delete.description: Deletes text at the cursor, backward or forward, by character or word.
text.delete.when: Use when simulating a delete or backspace key.

text.insert.description: Inserts typed text at the cursor.
text.insert.when: Use when typing at the current cursor position.

text.select.description: Selects text in a story by byte offsets.
text.select.when: Use when later text commands should act on a specific range.

toc.generate.description: Collects paragraphs in given styles into a table of contents frame with page numbers, leader and title.
toc.generate.when: Use when building a table of contents from heading styles.

toc.update.description: Rebuilds the table of contents from the current headings and page numbers.
toc.update.when: Use when pages or headings changed after generating the table of contents.

transform.info.description: Returns position, size, rotation and shear of the selected objects.
transform.info.when: Use when you need current geometry before transforming.

transform.move.description: Moves objects by dx and dy.
transform.move.when: Use when shifting objects by a relative distance.

transform.resize.description: Resizes objects from one rectangle to another, optionally scaling their content.
transform.resize.when: Use when objects must fit a target rectangle.

transform.rotate.description: Rotates objects by an angle around a reference point.
transform.rotate.when: Use when turning objects by a number of degrees.

transform.scale.description: Scales objects by factors sx and sy around a reference point.
transform.scale.when: Use when enlarging or shrinking objects by a ratio.

transform.set.description: Sets absolute x, y, width, height, rotation and shear of objects from a reference point.
transform.set.when: Use when objects need exact absolute values; use move for relative shifts.

type.attrs.description: Sets character and paragraph attributes by model name on the selected text or a style; null removes one.
type.attrs.when: Use when you need an attribute not covered by the simple character or paragraph commands.

type.attrsCatalog.description: Lists every character or paragraph attribute with choices, description and current value.
type.attrsCatalog.when: Use when you need attribute names and values before calling type.attrs.

type.changeCase.description: Changes the case of the selected text: upper, lower, title or sentence.
type.changeCase.when: Use when text capitalization needs converting.

type.char.description: Sets character formatting such as size, font, style, leading, tracking and fill on selected text.
type.char.when: Use when applying direct character formatting.

type.clearOverrides.description: Clears local overrides on the selection, character, paragraph or both, back to the applied style.
type.clearOverrides.when: Use when text should return to its style's formatting.

type.createOutlines.description: Turns text frames into filled paths, one per text color; anchored objects are not kept.
type.createOutlines.when: Use when text must become editable shapes or avoid font dependency.

type.fillWithPlaceholder.description: Fills text frames with placeholder text.
type.fillWithPlaceholder.when: Use when you need dummy copy to test a layout.

type.fontAxes.description: Returns variation axes and named instances of a variable font.
type.fontAxes.when: Use when you need axis tags and ranges before setting font variations.

type.onPath.description: Puts text on a path, with start position, flip and alignment.
type.onPath.when: Use when text should follow a curve or line.

type.openType.description: Sets OpenType features such as ligatures, fractions, small caps and stylistic sets on selected text.
type.openType.when: Use when enabling or disabling OpenType typographic features.

type.para.description: Sets paragraph formatting such as alignment, indents, spacing, tabs, rules, shading, borders and nested styles.
type.para.when: Use when applying direct paragraph formatting.

type.pathOptions.description: Changes options of text on a path: alignment, flip and start, or deletes it.
type.pathOptions.when: Use when adjusting text already placed on a path.

type.selectionAttrs.description: Returns the attributes of the current text selection.
type.selectionAttrs.when: Use when you need to know the current formatting before changing it.

variables.define.description: Defines a text variable such as custom text, running header, chapter number, date, file name or last page number.
variables.define.when: Use when text should be generated automatically and updated.

variables.delete.when: Use when a variable is no longer used.

variables.insert.description: Inserts a text variable at the cursor.
variables.insert.when: Use when placing a defined variable into the text.

variables.list.when: Use when you need variable names before inserting or deleting.

xml.deleteDtd.description: Deletes the loaded DTD from the document.
xml.deleteDtd.when: Use when the XML structure should no longer be validated.

xml.deleteTag.description: Deletes an XML tag by name.
xml.deleteTag.when: Use when a tag is no longer needed.

xml.loadDtd.description: Loads a DTD from text to define the allowed XML structure.
xml.loadDtd.when: Use when you need to validate the tagged structure against rules.

xml.mapStyle.description: Maps a paragraph style to an XML tag, or clears the mapping.
xml.mapStyle.when: Use when styles should be turned into tags automatically.

xml.newTag.description: Creates an XML tag with a name and color.
xml.newTag.when: Use when you need a tag before tagging frames or text.

xml.structure.description: Returns the XML structure tree of the document.
xml.structure.when: Use when inspecting the tagged structure.

xml.tag.description: Tags selected frames with an XML tag, or removes the tag.
xml.tag.when: Use when marking whole frames as structure elements.

xml.tagText.description: Tags the selected text with an XML tag, or removes the tag.
xml.tagText.when: Use when marking part of a story as a structure element.

xml.tags.description: Lists the XML tags defined in the document.
xml.tags.when: Use when you need tag names before tagging.

xml.validate.description: Validates the document's XML structure against the loaded DTD.
xml.validate.when: Use when checking the structure before exporting XML.

xref.insert.description: Inserts a cross-reference to an anchor in a format such as page, paragraph text or paragraph and page.
xref.insert.when: Use when text should refer to another place with an automatic page or paragraph reference.

xref.list.description: Lists the cross-references in the document.

xref.update.description: Updates all cross-references to current page numbers and text.
xref.update.when: Use when pages or text changed and references may be stale.

path.knife.description: Cuts every selected closed shape a line or polyline crosses into separate shapes that keep their fill and stroke.
path.knife.when: Use when a shape must be split along a line, like slicing a circle in two.

path.shapeBuilder.description: Splits overlapping selected shapes into their regions, then merges the regions under the given points into one shape, or erases them with mode erase.
path.shapeBuilder.when: Use to combine some overlapping regions but not others, or to cut a region out where shapes overlap; use path.pathfinder when every region is treated alike.

footnote.options.description: Sets document-wide footnote numbering: the number style (arabic, roman, letters, padded, or symbols), the first number, numbering that restarts on every page or section, one sequence across all stories (scope document) instead of one per story, how many columns the footnotes are set in (columns 1 to 6, 0 to follow the text columns), run-in footnotes that run on as one paragraph (runIn, with runInSeparator between notes), and the prefix, suffix and separator before the note text.
footnote.options.when: Use when a publication wants roman or symbol footnotes, numbering that continues from an earlier part, brackets around the note number, short notes set in two or three columns under a single-column text, or many short notes run on as one paragraph to save space, as critical editions do.

style.character.add.description: Adds a character style on top of those already on the selected text, so several combine (each sets only what it defines, the later one winning); adding one already there moves it to the top.
style.character.add.when: Use when text needs two looks at once, such as a colour style and an emphasis style, without making a combined style.

style.character.remove.description: Takes one character style off the selected text and keeps the others.
style.character.remove.when: Use to drop one look from text that carries several character styles.

object.envelope.description: Bends the selected art as one piece: into the topmost closed shape (topObject), on a grid of movable points (mesh), or around pins (puppet); moves edit an existing envelope, release removes it, expand bakes it into paths.
object.envelope.when: Use to fit art or a pattern into a shape (a flag, a bottle, a badge), to bend a logo or illustration, or to pose a drawing by pins.

object.imageTrace.description: Turns a placed image into vector shapes, in black and white by a brightness threshold or as a palette of colours, clipped to the image frame; the image is replaced unless keep is set.
object.imageTrace.when: Use to vectorise a logo, sketch, scan or simple illustration so it scales cleanly and can be recoloured; photos give many shapes.

path.livePaint.description: Fills the regions under points with a colour, where regions are formed by overlapping closed shapes and open lines crossing them; the fills go behind the outlines.
path.livePaint.when: Use to colour in line art or a drawing made of crossing strokes without building each region's shape by hand.

object.brush.description: Draws a stroke with a brush: calligraphic (an angled pen nib that thickens and thins with direction), scatter (copies of a symbol along the path) art (a symbol's art stretched along the whole path) or pattern (a symbol repeated as tiles bent along the path, restarting after each sharp corner, with optional start, end and corner tiles, stretched or spaced to fit); none restores the plain stroke.
object.brush.when: Use for hand-lettered or inked lines, decorative borders of repeated motifs, and strokes shaped like a drawn object such as a ribbon, banner or tapered stroke.

object.recolor.description: Recolours the selected art and everything inside it: swaps listed colours (keeping swatch links) and shifts hue, saturation or brightness of the rest, including extra fills and strokes and freeform gradient points.
object.recolor.when: Use to try a colour variation of an illustration, match art to a brand palette, or make a greyscale or lighter version.

symbol.create.description: Turns the selected art into a named document symbol and leaves an instance in its place.
symbol.create.when: Use when the same artwork (an icon, logo, badge, tree) will appear many times and should update everywhere from one definition.

symbol.place.description: Places another instance of a symbol, centred at a point and scaled.
symbol.place.when: Use to add more copies of a symbol; move, scale and rotate them like any object.

symbol.break.description: Replaces symbol instances with editable copies of the symbol's art in the same place and size.
symbol.break.when: Use when one copy must differ from the symbol.

symbol.redefine.description: Makes the selected art the symbol's new definition; every instance updates at once.
symbol.redefine.when: Use to change every copy of a symbol together.

symbol.list.description: Lists the document's symbols with how many instances each has.
symbol.list.when: Use before placing, redefining or deleting a symbol to learn its exact name.

symbol.delete.description: Deletes a symbol that has no instances left.
symbol.delete.when: Use to tidy unused symbols out of a document.

object.repeat.description: Repeats the selected art live as a radial ring, a grid (optionally mirrored on alternate rows or columns) or a mirrored pair; release removes it, expand makes the copies real objects.
object.repeat.when: Use for wreaths, rosettes, clock faces, patterns, tiles and symmetric designs where editing one piece should update every copy.

object.opacityMask.description: Groups the selection and uses the topmost object's brightness as the opacity of the rest; clip false keeps what lies outside visible; release turns the mask back into an object.
object.opacityMask.when: Use for fades into the page, vignettes, or any see-through shaped by a gradient or picture.

object.clippingMask.description: Groups the selection and clips it to the topmost object's shape, whose own fill and stroke stop drawing; release makes it an ordinary object again.
object.clippingMask.when: Use to show art only inside a shape (Draw Inside), like a pattern inside a letter or a photo collage in a circle.

object.isolateBlending.description: Makes a group's blend modes affect only its own members, not what lies behind the group.
object.isolateBlending.when: Use when multiply or screen inside a group should not tint the background.

object.freeformGradient.description: Fills a shape with colours placed at points across its bounds that blend smoothly, with a spread controlling how far each reaches; clear restores the fill.
object.freeformGradient.when: Use for soft multi-colour backgrounds, glows and organic colour fields that a linear or radial gradient cannot make.

object.effect.description: Adds, replaces or removes a live effect in the object's effect stack: round corners, zig zag, roughen, pucker and bloat, twist, a repeated transform with copies, or a warp (arc, arch, bulge, flag, wave, rise, fisheye, inflate, squeeze and the shells).
object.effect.when: Use for wavy, jagged, rough, spiky, puffy, twisted or repeated-copy looks that should stay editable; object.expandAppearance bakes them.

object.appearance.description: Adds, replaces or removes extra fills and strokes on an object, each with its own colour, opacity, weight, dash and effects, drawn under the main fill or over the main stroke.
object.appearance.when: Use for double or triple outlines, an offset outline under the fill, or a second translucent fill, without making extra objects.

object.expandAppearance.description: Bakes live effects into editable paths and turns extra fills and strokes into separate objects grouped with the original.
object.expandAppearance.when: Use before editing an effect's points by hand, or when exporting to a tool that does not know the effects.

object.widthProfile.description: Gives strokes a variable width along the path from a named profile (lens, taperStart, taperEnd, bulge, pinch, wave) or width points, or restores an even stroke.
object.widthProfile.when: Use for calligraphic or tapered strokes, swelling lines and brush-like outlines; follow with path.outlineStroke to make the shape fillable.

object.blend.description: Makes evenly spaced intermediate steps between two objects, interpolating shape, colours, stroke weight and opacity; the step count can come from a distance between steps, a third path can be the spine the blend follows, and live: true keeps the blend editable, rebuilding the steps whenever an end, the spine or the settings change.
object.blend.when: Use when the person asks for a blend, a colour or size progression, a row of objects morphing from one to another, objects spaced every so many points, or a blend along a curve; make it live when they will keep adjusting the ends.

object.drawMode.description: Sets where newly drawn objects go: on top (normal), directly beneath the selected object or at the back (behind), or clipped inside the one selected closed shape, which keeps its own fill and stroke (inside); with no mode it cycles.
object.drawMode.when: Use before drawing when new shapes should go under existing artwork, or should be drawn inside a shape such as a circle that crops them.

object.isolate.description: Enters isolation mode for the selected group (or the group holding the selected object): clicks and marquees pick only its members and everything else is dimmed; exit: true leaves it and selects the group.
object.isolate.when: Use when the person wants to work inside one group without ungrouping it or disturbing the artwork around it.

object.blend.expand.description: Turns a live blend into an ordinary group of its ends and steps, which stop following the ends and can be selected and edited one by one.
object.blend.expand.when: Use when the person wants to edit individual steps of a live blend, or to fix a blend so it no longer changes.

object.blend.release.description: Removes the steps of a live blend and ungroups it, leaving the two ends and any spine as separate objects.
object.blend.release.when: Use when the person wants to undo a live blend but keep the original objects.

shape.spiral.description: Draws an open spiral with a radius, a decay percentage per quarter turn and a number of segments.
shape.spiral.when: Use when the person asks for a spiral or swirl.

shape.arc.description: Draws an open or closed arc between two points, bowed by a slope from concave to convex.
shape.arc.when: Use when the person asks for an arc, a curved corner line or a quarter shape.

shape.grid.description: Draws a rectangular grid of evenly spaced lines with its frame as one path.
shape.grid.when: Use when a drawn grid or table-like line pattern is needed, not a real table.

shape.polarGrid.description: Draws concentric rings and radial dividers inside a rectangle as one path.
shape.polarGrid.when: Use when the person asks for a target, radar or polar grid.

transform.reflect.description: Mirrors the selection across a horizontal, vertical or angled axis through its centre, optionally as a copy.
transform.reflect.when: Use when a mirrored copy or reflection at an angle is needed; transform.flip only flips in place.

transform.shear.description: Slants the selection by an angle along the horizontal or vertical axis, optionally as a copy.
transform.shear.when: Use when the person asks to skew or slant objects.

transform.each.description: Scales, rotates, reflects and moves each selected object about its own centre.
transform.each.when: Use when several objects must each turn or shrink in place rather than as one group.
